summary: Israel does evil, delivered into Midian 7 years, Midianites Amalekites come like locusts devour produce, Israel impoverished cries to Yahweh, prophet says I brought you from Egypt but you not obeyed. Angel of Yahweh comes sits under oak at Ophrah where Gideon son of Joash threshing wheat in winepress to hide from Midian, angel says Yahweh is with you mighty warrior, Gideon says if Yahweh with us why all this happened, where are wonders fathers told, Yahweh delivered us to Midian. Yahweh says go in this might of yours save Israel from Midian have I not sent you? Gideon says my clan weakest in Manasseh I am least in father's house, Yahweh says I will be with you you shall strike Midian as one man. Gideon asks sign, bring offering, angel touches with tip of staff fire consumes offering, angel departs, Gideon fears have seen angel face to face, Yahweh says Peace be to you fear not you shall not die, Gideon builds altar Yahweh-Shalom. That night Yahweh says take father's bull second bull seven years old throw down altar of Baal and Asherah beside it and build altar to Yahweh, cut down Asherah, offer second bull, Gideon takes ten servants does by night fear, morning men see Baal altar thrown down Asherah cut, who did this? Gideon son of Joash, men say bring out son that he may die, Joash says will you contend for Baal? If he is god let him contend for himself because one has thrown down his altar. Therefore called Jerubbaal let Baal contend. Midian gathered, Spirit of Yahweh came on Gideon, blew trumpet, Abiezer gathered, sends messengers, asks fleece signs: fleece wet ground dry then reverse.
whyItMatters: Gideon's call — mighty warrior who feels weakest, fleece signs, Spirit comes on Gideon, 300 defeat Midian — shows God uses least, and faith seeking assurance.

keyVerses.text: Yahweh’s angel appeared to him, and said to him, “Yahweh is with you, you mighty man of valor!”
keyVerses.why: Call — mighty warrior to hiding farmer.

keyVerses.text: He said to him, “O Lord, how shall I save Israel? Behold, my family is the poorest in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father’s house.”
keyVerses.why: Weakest clan least member — I will be with you basis.

keyVerses.text: Then Gideon built an altar there to Yahweh, and called it “Yahweh is Peace.” To this day it is still in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
keyVerses.why: Yahweh-Shalom altar after fear not you shall not die.

questions.question: Why does angel call Gideon mighty warrior while he is threshing wheat in winepress to hide?
questions.answer: Winepress is pit, not threshing floor hill where wind winnows — Gideon hides from Midian who devour produce. Angel says Yahweh is with you mighty warrior (gibbor chayil) — same term for elite soldiers. Ironic — hiding farmer called mighty. Gideon replies if Yahweh with us why all this? Where are wonders fathers told? Complaint mirrors Israel's cries. God says go in this might of yours — what might? Weakness plus presence. Pattern: God sees differently than man, calls fearful to be brave.

questions.question: What does 'my clan weakest in Manasseh I am least' and 'I will be with you' mean?
questions.answer: Gideon says clan is dal — weak, poorest, least. Manasseh is half tribe, Abiezer small clan. He is youngest least in father's house. Human ranking: last. God's answer not you are not weak but I will be with you you shall strike as one man. Strength is presence, not pedigree. For zero-background: God often chooses least likely to show deliverance is not by human might. Gideon still needs assurance — signs, altar, fire, fleece — shows faith can coexist with needing confirmation.

questions.question: Why throw down Baal altar at night and why fleece signs wet/dry?
questions.answer: Father Joash had Baal altar and Asherah pole — idolatry in own house. Yahweh says second bull seven years old (Midian oppression 7 years) throw down Baal altar cut Asherah build proper altar to Yahweh offer bull. Gideon fears household and city so does by night with ten servants. Morning men demand death, Joash defends: will you contend for Baal? If god let him contend — let Baal defend self. Called Jerubbaal — let Baal contend against him. Then Spirit comes on Gideon blows trumpet, but still asks fleece signs: fleece wet ground dry, then ground wet fleece dry — seeks confirmation. God patiently gives both. Shows God works with hesitant obedience, not just heroic faith.

glossary.def: Elite warrior, mighty man of valor — ironic title for hiding farmer.
Contend — if Baal is god let him defend his own altar.
Wool fleece wet dry tests seeking confirmation — God grants patiently.
